First booking was denied by the property owner of one hotel stating his property does not have a tie-up with Oyo anymore. So had to contact Oyo customer service to switch hotel. They did switch and booked this hotel close to the previous location. This hotel was good. Room was clean. Had most basic amenities.
negative_snippets:
The hotel staff was not even considerate towards us. Whenever I think OYO is improving their service, I end up having a very bad experience right after.

1. I asked the staff for a towel. They said, "Abhi ladka aayega, de jayega," but even after 5 hours of check-in, no one came with the towel. I eventually checked out. ( Last time they do the same thing but we thought it is not important to file a complaint.)

2. I asked the staff for a remote. They said, "Abhi ladka aayega, de jayega, or aap aas-paas wale room mein dekh lo," but again, no one came.

3. They gave us water in a one-time-use Bisleri bottle, but the bottle was already used and completely crushed.

4. Their staff came four times just to ask for the check-in OTP. They didn’t even know where to enter the OTP—we had to help them with it.

5. The lift was not working, which was the worst part. I asked them to start it, and they said, "Kharab hai, complaint kiya hua hai." Then, after two hours, the lift started working.

6. We arrived early, around 11:30 AM, and asked for the room. They said, "200 rupees extra lagenge agar abhi chahiye toh, warna 12 baje room milega." After a small discussion, they gave us the room.

This is wrong—they should focus on making our experience better, not worse.

Bad experience. Bedsheets had holes. Washroom was super UNHYGIENIC. The glasses provided in the hotel room were sticky. No sealed water bottles available in the hotel. Had to order water as well as disposable glasses from blinkit.
No soap given despite asking multiple times, gave me a shampoo pouch to wash hands. Only the mosquitoes were happy there, since they were in plenty. Also no All-out was given.
